statement: The client has a Cautious risk profile (risk class 2), a 6-year investment horizon, an income objective, and a limited capacity to bear losses with a maximum acceptable drawdown of 10%. The proposed portfolio consists of Xtrackers II EUR Overnight Rate Swap UCITS ETF 1C (SRI 1) and Carmignac Sécurité AW EUR Acc (SRI 2). The suitability assessment confirms that the portfolio is fully suitable for the client as its risk parameters align with the Cautious profile limits. Furthermore, the portfolio supports the client's income objective and matches their 6-year investment horizon. The client does not have any short-term liquidity needs within the next two years.
